lines.text: This pineapple took about two years to grow.
lines.caption: This pineapple took about 2 years to grow.

lines.text: And how it's built is even stranger.
Pineapples don't grow on trees. They grow from a spiky plant in the ground.
From planting, it takes about eighteen to twenty-four months to get the first fruit.
lines.caption: From planting, it takes about 18 to 24 months to get the first fruit.

lines.text: And each plant makes just one pineapple at a time.
The strange part? It starts as dozens of tiny purple flowers,
that fuse together into a single fruit.
Sounds fake? It's true. Follow for more.
